newsitem.title: USA: Senetek extends Kinetin skin study.
newsitem.headline: Senetek extends Kinetin skin study.

text.p: Senetek PLC said on Thursday that it will extend a clinical study begun October 1996 to 12 months from six months, of its patented aging- and photodamaged-skin treatment, Kinetin.
Senetek said that results have been very encouraging at halfway point of what was scheduled to be a 26-week study.
A company spokeswoman said that researchers want to see what happens with treatment over a longer period of time.
Kinetin is a highly potent growth factor that, along with other plant- growth substances, promotes cell division and ensures orderly growth and development of plants.
Senetek said that in a study, Kinetin delayed or prevented a range of cellular changes associated with in vitro aging of human skin cells.
